security_spec.violation_condition: Linux kernel context-switch or KVM vCPU switch saves/restores shpmspc and shpmsdata but omits the newly added shpmsdetailsbt1, shpmsdetailsbt2, and shpmsdetailsdata CSRs, or the perf subsystem exposes the Sspesa sample record (which now includes shpmsdetailsbt1/bt2 branch target PCs) to userspace without sanitization, allowing a process to read branch-target PC values from a previously scheduled process or privilege mode.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: save/restore of shpmspc without corresponding save/restore of shpmsdetailsbt1|shpmsdetailsbt2|shpmsdetailsdata; or copy_to_user of Sspesa sample record containing raw branch-target PCs
security_spec.summary: New Sspesa metadata CSRs (shpmsdetailsbt1/bt2 branch target PCs, shpmsdetailsdata with retire-state/CAUSE, shpmsdetailscc) extend per-sample state that the kernel must context-switch and sanitize before exposing to userspace via perf; omitting them leaks branch-target addresses (ASLR bypass) and execution metadata across process/VM boundaries

findings.finding: Sspesa CSRs (shpmspc, shpmsdata, shpmsdetailsbt1, shpmsdetailsbt2, shpmsdetailsdata) are not defined anywhere in the kernel. Only Zicfiss CSR_SSP (0x011) is defined. No Sspesa context-switch or KVM vCPU switch code exists to audit.

Context-switch path saves/restores only CSR_SSP (Zicfiss user-mode shadow stack pointer). No save/restore of Sspesa CSRs (shpmspc, shpmsdata, shpmsdetailsbt1, shpmsdetailsbt2, shpmsdetailsdata) because Sspesa is not implemented in this kernel.
KVM VCPU switch only exchanges CSR_SENVCFG. No Sspesa CSR save/restore (shpmspc, shpmsdata, shpmsdetailsbt1, shpmsdetailsbt2, shpmsdetailsdata) because Sspesa is not implemented.
findings.snippet:
csrr    t0, CSR_SENVCFG
REG_S    t0, ...
ld    t0, ...
csrw    CSR_SENVCFG, t0

findings.finding: Perf subsystem uses standard frame-pointer-based callchain walking. No Sspesa sample record (with shpmsdetailsbt1/bt2 branch-target PCs) is read or exposed to userspace because Sspesa is not implemented.
findings.snippet: No Sspesa perf sample record handling found.
